$comment: PUBLIC re-run manifest - the real repositories behind the benchmark, each with the commit its committed run resolved to, and the label -> repo mapping. Every url/commit pair was copied field-by-field from a committed results*/<name>/meta.json (field "commit", written by benchmark/run.mjs from git rev-parse HEAD); none was typed by hand and no SHA is taken from a target list. WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: benchmark/repos.json (tracked) carries the label list used by benchmark/results/ (target-1..target-4 as aliases, empty urls), so a fresh clone could not tell which repositories were benchmarked at all - targets.json is what makes the sample re-runnable. WHY IT CARRIES THE LABEL MAPPING (label_map below): the mapping was never actually private - it shipped from the start in the tracked benchmark/anonymize-results.mjs (LABEL_MAP) and each results/target-N/meta.json keeps its commit - so withholding it bought no anonymity while making the sample look cherry-picked and the scores unverifiable. It is now published because reproducibility matters more; benchmark/README.md "Target anonymity" tells that story in full. label_map values are copied from that LABEL_MAP, not retyped from memory. NOT READ BY run.mjs: it is a manifest, not a run input. To reproduce one run: git clone <url> benchmark/work/<name> && git -C benchmark/work/<name> checkout <commit>, then node benchmark/run.mjs --only <name> - run.mjs reuses a clone that already exists in benchmark/work/<name> instead of re-cloning, resolves HEAD from it and records that same commit in meta.json.

label_map.$comment: The one-time disclosure, published 2026-10-06. Keys are the labels used by the committed evidence in benchmark/results/<label>/; values are the target names in this file. Copied from LABEL_MAP in benchmark/anonymize-results.mjs:52-57 (chatbot-ui -> target-1, roomgpt -> target-2, screenshot-to-code -> target-3, llamacoder -> target-4).
